d: Bihar Train Cancelled List : kya aapne bhi disanbar ki chhuttiyon men kahin ghumne jane ka plan banaya hai... ya phir aane vale mahinon men bihar se kisi dusre shahar tak tren se saphar karne vale hain...agar han, to ghar se nikalne se pahle ye khabar jarur jan lijie.... kyonki relve ke ek phaisle se bihar ke hajaron rel yatriyon ki pareshani barh sakti hai... disanbar 2026 se lekar march 2027 tak kaee mahatvapurn trenen radd rahne vali hain... itna hi nahin, kuchh trenon ke phere bhi kam kar die gae hain...ab saval hai ki aakhir relve ne kin-kin trenon ko radd kiya hai... kya aapki tren…
